decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces shall be timber stained dark brown unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The detached outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwelling house known as 49 Oxford Road South, Chiswick and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities)
description: Erection of a single storey detached rear outbuilding for use as summerhouse/storage shed
